notes.text: Isindleko manje singahlukaniswa Ngokwemali engenayo, futhi imali engenayo oyithayiphayo yabiwa namalungu eqembu.
Isindleko ngasinye ku-Izindleko zakamuva ze-Ikhaya manje sinemenyu: Hlela, Phinda, Yabelana noSusa.
Ukuthi Bona konke ku-Ikhaya manje kuvula i-Zonke izindleko: zonke izindleko ongaphakathi kuzo, kuwo wonke amaqembu akho, nokusesha, izihlungi nokuhlela.
Isithombe seqembu manje sikhulu phezulu esikrinini salo futhi siyancipha njengoba uskrola, futhi ukuvula iqembu kunopopayi kusuka emugqeni walo.
I-Umsebenzi manje ibonisa izithombe zabantu, i-Amabhalansi › Ngeqembu ibonisa isithombe seqembu ngalinye, futhi ukuthi Isindleko esikhulu kunazo zonke ku-Izibalo kubonisa isigaba saso.
I-Iphrofayela › I-akhawunti nokuvumelanisa manje ibonisa ilogo ye-Google noma ye-Apple ne-imeyili yakho yonke, ebonwa nguwe kuphela.
Ukuthi Susa i-akhawunti manje kuchaza ukuthi yini esala emaqenjini akho ngemva kokuba i-akhawunti yakho ingasekho.
Inkinobho ethi Ukhiye we-Pix ozenzakalelayo ayisabukeki ivaliwe kukhiye wakho ozenzakalelayo kutimu emnyama.
